subject: MAP: Acceptance gates and timeline (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / Retention)
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@arborbank.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Victor Chen <victor.chen@arborbank.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & MAP: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention window

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo this week — the team at ArborBank liked the latency profile and the dedicated/private options. We need to formalize a mutual action plan so internal stakeholders (security, legal, ops) can sign off. High-level asks from our side: 

- SOC 2 report (latest) and a short summary of control owners.
- SIG/CAIQ baseline answers for the model-serving stack.
- DPA draft we can redline (data residency and processor obligations).
- Clarify retention windows for embeddings and raw request logs, and whether we offer shorter retention SLAs for regulated customers.

Can you propose a MAP with acceptance gates and a tentative close timeline? Ideally we want a decision by the end of Q4. I can pull in Legal (Rajiv) if needed.

Best,
Asha

--
Asha Rao
Head of Platform Risk, ArborBank
asha.rao@arborbank.com
(415) 555-0183
From: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, asha.rao@arborbank.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & MAP: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention window

Thanks Asha — happy to own the MAP for Redwood. Draft attached: 'mutual_action_plan_v0.9.docx'.

Quick proposal (high level):

1) Entry criteria (Week 0):
- NDA executed (done)
- Technical discovery completed (we did the demo)

2) Security gates (Weeks 1-3):
- Redwood provides latest SOC 2 Type II report and control-owner list (deliverable: SOC2 package).
- SIG/CAIQ answers for our serving stack; technical clarifications call for any high-risk items.
- SOC 2 + SIG acceptance path: Security issues triaged; any high-severity items must have remediation plan + ETA.

3) Legal gates (Weeks 2-4):
- Share DPA (we attach a standard template).
- ArborBank to return redline by EOW Week 3.
- If data residency carveouts required, escalate to Legal + Solutions for Private deployment options.

4) Operational gates (Weeks 2-5):
- Agree on retention windows for embeddings and raw logs: default 90 days; optional 30/7-day SLAs for enterprise.
- Define shared test-drive SLOs for pilot.

5) Close (Week 6):
- Sign (DocuSign) and schedule production cutover.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v0.9.docx, soc2_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx (SOC2 sample items).

Can Ben/Legal (Jordan) advise on the DPA cadence and whether our standard 90-day default retention is likely to be a blocker for ArborBank?

Thanks — I'll set up a short kickoff for Monday to get Security and Legal in the same room.

-Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@arborbank.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, asha.rao@arborbank.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood DPA redline + residency question

Hi Jasmine / Jordan,

Attached is a redline of your DPA (redline_dpa_arborbank.pdf). Two items we flagged as must-haves:

1) Data residency: ArborBank requires EU/US tenant isolation for customer data with a hard requirement that production inference for EU customers remains in EU regions. We understand you offer Private deployments — please confirm if that changes timelines or cost.

2) Embeddings and logs retention: We propose 30 days for raw request logs and 365 days for embeddings (business records). If Redwood can offer a configurable retention profile per-account (30/90/365), that would be ideal.

We aim to complete legal redlines in two weeks so Solutions/Security can finish the MAP acceptance.

Thanks,
Rajiv

--
Rajiv Menon
General Counsel, ArborBank
rajiv.menon@arborbank.com
From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: asha.rao@arborbank.com, rajiv.menon@arborbank.com
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 14:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA redline + residency question

Asha / Rajiv — thank you for the redline and the clear residency + retention asks. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Residency: Confirmed — for EU production inference we can route and pin traffic to EU regions (hosted EU) and for stricter isolation we can provision a Private deployment in the EU. Private deployment will add provisioning lead time (~4-6 weeks) and a pricing uplift; I'll have Ops share a scoped estimate by EOW.

- Retention: We can support configurable retention tiers per-account. Default is 90 days for raw logs and 90 days for embeddings today, but we will commit to ship a 30-day raw-logs profile and a 365-day embeddings profile as part of the onboarding scope for ArborBank. Deliverable: soc2_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx lists where retention controls show up in our SOC 2 controls (see tab 'retention').

- Timeline: Based on the MAP, and assuming Legal returns final DPA within two weeks, projected close is the end of Week 6 from MAP kickoff. If ArborBank opts for Private EU deployment, add 4-6 weeks for provisioning and an updated MRR proposal.

Action items:
- Jordan: prepare DPA counter (we will accept most of the redlines but need to discuss certain processor obligations).
- Jasmine: schedule a 45-min security walkthrough (SIG clarifications + SOC2 traceability) with ArborBank SecOps this week.
- Ben/Ops: deliver Private EU estimate by Friday.

Attachments: soc2_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx
Links: DocuSign envelope created for DPA (see related_links).

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
